context.person: A person using a university registration portal
context.user_goal: Choose before the reservation deadline after reviewing the conflicting class.

product_state.preceding_state: A seat opened in a full course and was offered to the first person on the waitlist.
product_state.current_state: The seat is reserved until September 17 at noon. Accepting adds the course to the schedule.
known_facts: The seat is reserved until September 17 at noon.
Accepting adds the course to the schedule.
The course overlaps another registered class.
Declining keeps the existing schedule and removes the person from this waitlist.
forbidden_claims: Ignoring the offer preserves the waitlist position.

current_content.subject: An update for you
current_content.heading: Heads up!
current_content.body: Some details have changed. Review your account.

challenge: Rewrite the transactional email so the person can understand course waitlist seat offered, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Review the conflict and accept the offered seat.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Decline the seat and keep the current schedule.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: Accepting creates a schedule conflict; no response releases the seat.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Choose before the reservation deadline after reviewing the conflicting class.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
